grg.review: Sir teaches extremely well and marks very leniently. Just attend his classes and note down as he says you will be good to go[cite: 14].

Except final, all quizzes and mid exam questions are easy, final is a bit tricky compared to other faculty. Very easygoing. Total 3 quizzes (best 2). No viva or lab exam. Most importantly, if you write main and wrong but formula choosing is right, you'll get partial marks. Sir doesn't curve, even for 0.05 mark[cite: 18].

mhm.review: MHM is one of the few faculty members in NSU who is an absolute legend, but people don't get him properly. He teaches every concept in a detailed manner[cite: 13, 14].
Takes 9 quizzes and will count all of them. 2 mids each of 100 marks. 1 final. Very strict, classes are not easygoing, but good for learning if you put in the effort[cite: 13, 14].

mkz.review: Sir will try his utmost to make sure everyone understands each and every topic, and questions are from the slides, sometimes he doesn't even change the numbers. Very easy to get a good grade[cite: 14].
Sir bhalo porae. Partial marking o kore for maths. Consistent thakle A/A- pawa is no big deal[cite: 18].

mmtn.review: Sir is very old and at times cannot explain things properly. Lectures are boring and difficult to understand. However, he curves a lot and takes makeup exams if majority do poorly[cite: 14, 18].

rsj.review: Teaches very well conceptually and provides practice problems before exams. Exams test conceptual understanding, and she provides partial marks. However, she can be strict/demanding and does not curve much[cite: 14, 18].

zkh3.review: Klashe ja poran okhanthekei exam e ashbe, grading bhalo. Sir normally slide er question gula exam e repeat kore. Marking onek valo, also curves[cite: 18].
